examples.title: A week of windows
examples.description: One row per day. Today sits on the surface, a live window carries an inverted On now pill, and a time range never breaks inside.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { WeekSchedule } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<WeekSchedule
  label="Happy hour"
  days={[
    { day: 'Mon', start: '2:00 pm', end: '8:00 pm', description: 'Half-price wells' },
    { day: 'Tue', start: '2:00 pm', end: '8:00 pm', description: 'Taco and margarita special', today: true, live: true },
    { day: 'Wed', start: '4:00 pm', end: '7:00 pm', description: 'Draft pints' },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: A window that crosses midnight
examples.description: Set endsNextDay when the window ends after midnight. The range still reads on one line.
examples.code:
<script lang="ts">
  import { WeekSchedule } from '@lostgradient/cinder';
</script>

<WeekSchedule
  label="Late night"
  days={[
    { day: 'Fri', start: '10:00 pm', end: '2:00 am', endsNextDay: true, description: 'Late-night menu' },
    { day: 'Sat', start: '10:00 pm', end: '2:00 am', endsNextDay: true, description: 'Late-night menu' },
  ]}
/>
